t0029-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0029-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0029-02.gloss: A family water warning follows a field crew rinse and leaves the source uncertain.
t0029-02.rival_reading: A containment crew could have rinsed a trailer tank during cleanup; the warning does not establish what caused the danger.
